noMailboxes.title: No mailboxes yet
noMailboxes.body: {what, select, archive {Import and export} away {An away message} identities {A send-as address} junk {Junk} privacy {Privacy} rules {A filter} other {A signature}} is set per mailbox. <link>Connect one</link> and this screen fills in.

sendCheck.notStarted: That check could not be started.
sendCheck.idle: Sends a message from this mailbox to itself and reports what happens to it.

signature.placeholder: Your name, and whatever else belongs at the bottom of your mail.
signature.whenHint: A signature you have to insert by hand every time is one you never send.
signature.aboveLabel: Put the signature above the quoted message
signature.aboveHint: Above is what most people expect on a reply. Below is what a mailing list expects.

away.toggle: Answer mail to {address} while I am away
away.subject: Subject, if you want one other than "Re: their subject"
away.bodyPlaceholder: I am away until the 12th and will answer when I am back.
away.repeat: Answer the same person again after
away.never: Never answered: a mailing list, a bounce, another away message, an address like no-reply, or anybody already answered inside the window above. Being blind-copied on something does not count as being written to.

labels.hint: A label reaches across every mailbox, which is what a folder cannot do. Filters can put one on automatically.
labels.name: Name
labels.count: {count, plural, =0 {on nothing} one {on # message} other {on # messages}}
labels.deleteHint: Delete the label {name}. The mail it is on is not touched.
labels.deleted: {name} is gone. The mail it was on is not.

blocked.noMailboxBody: Connect one and you can start refusing senders on it.
blocked.explain: Mail cannot be refused before it arrives. A message is delivered to your mailbox by the sending server long before Polaris sees it, and no mail client can stop that - only your provider can. So a block here means the next best thing: everything from that address goes straight to the trash and never reaches your inbox. It still arrives and it still counts against your mailbox, but you never see it, and it goes somewhere you can get it back from rather than somewhere you cannot.
blocked.title: Blocked senders
blocked.empty: Nobody. Blocking one from a message adds them here.
blocked.caught: {count, plural, =0 { - nothing yet} one { - # message so far} other { - # messages so far}}
blocked.filters: Each of these is an ordinary filter, so you can open one in <link>Filters</link> to change what happens instead of throwing the mail away.

junk.noMailbox: Connect one and Polaris can start judging what arrives in it.
junk.forgetTitle: Forget what this filter has learned?
junk.forgetBody: Every Junk and Not junk you have pressed on this mailbox is taken back, and it starts again knowing nothing about your mail. Nothing moves: what is in Junk stays in Junk.
junk.explain: Your provider filters this mailbox before Polaris ever sees it, so what this catches is what got through - and it catches it using things your provider cannot know: who you write to, what you have already called junk, and what you fished back out. It runs here, on this machine, and no message is sent anywhere to be scored. If an address-reputation service is switched on in Integrations, the sender's address and the domain behind it are checked against it - the address, never the message.
junk.judgeHint: Anything clearly junk goes to the Junk folder. Anything only doubtful stays where it is and says so when you open it.
junk.offHint: Switching this off changes what happens to mail arriving afterward. It never moves or re-reads what is already here.
junk.nothingYet: Nothing yet. Pressing Junk on a message teaches it, and Not junk on one in the Junk folder teaches it the other way. Until then it goes on what it can check: who the sending server says the message is from, whether the name on it belongs to the address behind it, where its links go, and whether you have written to the sender.
junk.counts: {junk} marked as junk, {good} marked as not junk, and {words} {words, plural, one {word} other {words}} it has an opinion about.
junk.changeMind: Changing your mind about a message takes the first answer back, so pressing the wrong one is not permanent.

identities.title: Addresses {address} can send as
identities.hint: Whether the mail server accepts one is its decision. If it refuses, the message comes back with its reason.
identities.invalid: That is not an email address yet.
identities.taken: This mailbox can already send as that address.
identities.addressHint: Mail sent from this address still goes out through this mailbox.
identities.name: Name people will see
identities.replyTo: Replies go to, if not this address
identities.defaultLabel: Send from this address by default
identities.defaultToggle: Send from this one by default

archive.noMailbox: Connect one and you can bring an archive into it.
archive.tooBig: {limit} MB is the most Polaris can read in one file. Split the archive and bring the parts in one after another.
archive.noMessages: There are no messages in that file.
archive.importedSomeFailed: {done} messages are in {address}. {failed} could not be taken by the server.
archive.inBody: An .mbox file, or a single .eml, up to {limit} MB. Every message is put on your mail server in the folder above, so it is there on your phone and in everything else you read this mailbox with - not only here. They arrive already read, because an archive that lands as four thousand unread messages is an inbox nobody opens again.
archive.progress: {finished, select, yes {Done - } other {}}{done} of {total} imported{failed, plural, =0 {} other {, # the server would not take}}.
archive.twice: Nothing is matched against what is already in the folder, so importing the same file twice puts everything in twice. That is on purpose: a message quietly missing from an archive is worse than one that is there twice.
archive.outBody: An .mbox of everything Polaris holds for this {scope, select, folder {folder} other {mailbox}}, which every other mail client can read. It is built from what has been synced here, with the headers Polaris keeps - an archive rather than a forensic copy. To save one message exactly as its server holds it, open it and use Save this message.
archive.nothingYet: There is nothing here to download yet.
archive.inFile: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in the file.

templates.goneMailbox: A mailbox you no longer have
templates.hint: Insert one from the composer's toolbar. A template's subject fills the subject line when it is empty.
templates.deleteBody: Messages already written with it are not touched.
templates.offeredLabel: Which mailbox this template is offered for
templates.subjectPlaceholder: Left empty, the subject line is not touched

general.mailboxesHint: Mail normally follows the switch at the top of the screen, so you see your own mailboxes on your own shelf and a company's on its. Showing all of them puts every mailbox in one place, whichever is selected - and the counts and the new-mail notices follow whatever you choose here.
general.sortHint: What every list opens as. The buttons above a list still win for the page you are on, and that page is a link you can send.
general.markReadHint: Passing over a message in a reading pane is not the same as reading it, and a message marked read is a message lost.
general.afterFilingHint: Clearing four hundred messages by going back to the list each time is the job done twice.
general.undoHint: How long a message waits before it actually goes. Off means Send is final.
general.layoutHint: Remembered for this browser rather than for your account: a phone and a desk are not the same shape.
general.mailtoHint: Opens every mailto link you click - an email us link on any site - as a new message here. Your browser asks you to confirm, and can undo it from its own settings.
general.mailtoUnsupported: This browser cannot hand email links to a website. Chrome, Edge and Firefox can.
general.mailtoConfirm: Confirm it in the bar your browser shows.
general.mailtoRefused: This browser refused. It only allows it on a page opened over https.

block.title: Never load anything from outside
block.body: The strictest. Some messages will look broken, because they are mostly pictures.

trusted.title: Only from senders I have allowed
trusted.body: Stricter than it needs to be now that pictures come through Polaris, and slower to read: nothing is drawn until you allow that sender.

always.title: Show pictures
always.body: The usual choice. Polaris fetches them on your behalf, so the sender never learns your address, your browser, or when you opened it.

privacy.title: Pictures and anything else a message loads
privacy.lead: A message can carry an invisible picture that tells its sender the moment you opened it, from where, and on what. Polaris fetches every one of them for you, so what they get is a request from this server rather than anything about you.
privacy.nameTrackersHint: A message says how many trackers it carried and who they belong to, rather than only that something was blocked.
privacy.cleanLinks: Take the tracking out of links
privacy.cleanLinksHint: A link still goes where it says it goes; it stops carrying who followed it.
privacy.receiptsHint: Off, a sender who asks to be told you read their message is not told. Polaris still shows you that they asked.
privacy.codes: Throw away codes once they have expired
privacy.codesHint: A verification code stops working in a few minutes and then sits in your mailbox for years. Off by default: this deletes mail, so it is something to switch on rather than something to switch off.
privacy.keepLabel: How long a code is kept
privacy.thenTrash: then to the trash, where you can still get it back.
privacy.trustedEmpty: Nobody yet. Allowing a sender from inside a message adds them here.

accounts.linked: {provider} account authorized. Add the mailbox below and it will be offered without a password.
accounts.notPublic: {provider} had nowhere to send you back to. Polaris is only reachable on this network, and an address like that is one they refuse.
accounts.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to give Polaris a public address.
accounts.wrongAccount: That is not the {provider} account this mailbox is. Nothing was connected. Authorize the account whose address you typed, or add the mailbox with a password.
accounts.unfinished: That authorization did not finish. Nothing was changed.
accounts.title: Your mailboxes
accounts.lead: Connect as many as you like. They share one inbox and each keeps its own color.
accounts.emptyBody: Connect one and your mail is read here instead of in somebody else's browser tab.
accounts.unifiedLabel: Include this mailbox in the shared inbox
accounts.notifyHint: A notice from your system when new mail arrives here while Polaris is in another tab or window
accounts.notifyLabel: Tell me when new mail arrives in this mailbox
accounts.trashHint: Messages in this mailbox's trash are deleted on the mail server once they are this old
accounts.trashLabel: When this mailbox's trash is emptied
accounts.trashKeep: {days, plural, =0 {Until I empty it} other {After # days}}
accounts.removeBody: Polaris stops checking it and deletes what it holds for it: the mail it cached, its filters, templates, signature, send-as addresses, drafts and what its spam filter learned. Nothing on the mail server is touched.{oauth, select, yes { Your connected account stays connected: it is on your profile and may be authorizing other things too.} other {}}

state.checking: Checking the new details with its servers...
state.oauthRefused: {detail} Checking is paused until it is reconnected.
state.passwordRefused: {detail} Checking is paused until the password is updated.
state.passwordDefault: The server stopped accepting its password.

rules.title: Filters on {address}
rules.hint: Run on arrival, top to bottom. A rule set to stop there is the last one a message meets.
rules.empty: No filters. Everything that arrives goes to the inbox.
rules.name: Name it
rules.forwardHint: A copy is sent from this mailbox, and replies to it go to whoever wrote the original. It will not send to an address you have here - that is a loop - and a message that has already been forwarded once is left alone.
rules.similarShape: Matches subjects shaped like: {shape} (* is anything that changes)
rules.similarNothing: Nothing in that subject stays the same from one message to the next, so it would match nothing.

trigger.onSave: Saving it while it is on also applies it once to the mail already in the inbox.

editor.whenHint: Runs on every message that arrives in the inbox.
editor.ifHint: Conditions in a group combine as the group says. Add a group for an alternative.
editor.tooMany: This filter holds as many as it can.
editor.reorder: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow keys
editor.patternHint: A regular expression, checked against the first {count} characters.
editor.noFolders: This mailbox has no folders yet.
editor.noLabels: You have no labels yet. Add one under Labels.
editor.noVerified: Verify an address on your account to forward to it.
editor.stopHint: Filters below this one are not run on a message it matched.

canvas.toGroup: Conditions go into the selected group.
canvas.newGroup: Each condition starts a new group. Select a group to add to it.
canvas.always: Matches nothing until it has a condition.
canvas.unfinished: Not finished. Select it to fill it in.
canvas.pick: Select a node to change it.
canvas.reorderHint: Drag a node up or down, or select it and use the arrow keys, to change the order.
canvas.nodeHelp: Press Enter or Space to select it. The up and down arrows change its order and Delete removes it.
canvas.nodeHelpReadOnly: Press Enter or Space to select it.

list.copied: Filter duplicated. The copy is off until you turn it on.
list.deleteBody: Mail it already filed stays where it is.
list.full: This mailbox has as many filters as it can hold.
list.savedApplied: {count, plural, =0 {Filter saved. Nothing already in the inbox matched it.} one {Filter saved and applied to # message already in the inbox.} other {Filter saved and applied to # messages already in the inbox.}}
list.savedRunning: Filter saved. Applying it to the mail already in the inbox.
list.notForwarded: Mail already here is not forwarded.
list.unverified: Not forwarding: {to} is not a verified address on your account.
list.unreachable: Polaris could not be reached. Try again.
